title: Outcome of non-surgical treatment of Periodontitis in patients with osteoporosis and antiresorptive therapy
summary: Aim of the study is to assess the outcome of a systematic non-surgical periodontitits therapy in patients with Periodontitis and osteoporosis and antiresorptive drug intake.

interventions.name: non-surgical periodontitis therapy in periodontitis patients with osteoporosis and under antiresorptive therapy
non-surgical periodontitis therapy in periodontitis patients without osteoporosis/antiresorptive therapy

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
periodontitis and osteoporosis with intake of antiresorptive drugs
Exclusion criteria:
no consent, antiresorptive drug intake because of diseases other than osteoporosis, diseases associated with Need of antibiotic Prophylaxis in case of dental tratment
